newsitem.title: USA: US telecom exports up five pct in first half 1996.
newsitem.headline: US telecom exports up five pct in first half 1996.

text.p: U.S. exports of telecommunications equipment were $8 billion for the first six months of 1996, up five percent from the same period in 1995, the Telecommunications Industry Association said on Thursday.
The group, which culled the information from government data, said the telecommunications equipment sector had a trade surplus of $2 billion during this year's first six months.

Canada remained the largest export market at $1.2 billion, up 46 percent from the previous year. Among the top 10 markets, the Asian countries of Japan, South Korea, China and Hong Kong accounted for almost 30 percent of the total U.S. telecom export market at $2.3 billion.
